description: This file defines an Express.js router for managing 'recipe' resources. It sets up RESTful API endpoints for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting recipes, and includes Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all recipes.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a recipe by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new recipe.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a recipe by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a recipe by ID.
